bibl.title: The Memphite Sacerdotal Decree of 161 BC.
bibl.seg: Maxim Panov & Eddy Lanciers, The Memphite Sacerdotal Decree of 161 BC.
Journal of Egyptian History 16 (2023) pp. 30-82, figg.
bibl.note: Cairo, Egyptian Museum CG 22184. Synodal decree promulgated by the Egyptian priests under Ptolemy VI Philometor, 161 BCE. The most recent of the preserved Ptolemaic priestly decrees, it is of particular interest because it provides information on coronation ceremonies for Ptolemy VI in Memphis, and mentions a revolt or unrest. - 1. Introduction. - 2. Physical description - Scene - Provenance. - 3. Transliteration - Translation - Commentary. - 4. Conclusion. - 5. Selected graphics.
